title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
AN242
Race, Ethnicity and Nationalism
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
This
course
focuses on the study of race, ethnicity and nationalism as social structures of inclusion and
exclusion
. Themes to be addressed include how one's citizenship status determines access to labour and human rights, the links between gender, sexuality and machismo to ethnic and national matters, and the role of place in the formation of personal and collective identities.
